newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait M3 rises in February year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait M3 rises in February year-on-year.

text.p: Kuwait's broadly-defined M3 money supply rose to 7.490 billion dinars in February from 7.442 billion in February 1996, figures published in the Central Bank's monthly bulletin showed.
M1 = Currency in circulation with the public and private dinar sight deposits.

M2 = M1 plus dinar savings deposits, dinar time deposits, foreign currency deposits, and those certificates of deposit issued by Kuwaiti banks that are held by other parties (i.e. excluding those held by the banks themselves).
M3 = M2 plus private sector deposits with deposit-accepting investment companies.

The data covers eight commercial and specialised banks, the Islamic institution Kuwait Finance House KFHS.KW, a Kuwaiti branch of a Bahrain-based bank as well as domestic investment companies which take deposits.
